courses.note: Required in the Systems option; C3 is CS 325. Public Ecampus course-book syllabus; no term stated (page footer reads copyright 2024), so left undated. Prohibits submitting any content generated by ML tools such as ChatGPT and Copilot.

notes: OSU CS syllabi are mostly inside Canvas and not public. The EECS class-list pages did not expose links to course sites for Fall 2025 through Fall 2026. University position: AI use is an instructor-level choice (CTL guidance; Faculty Senate draft AI syllabus statement policy, May 2026). Frame follows the 2025-26 Corvallis Systems option plan, in which CS 162 follows ENGR 103.
